caption: Apartment towers climbing the green slopes of Medellín's valley
alt: Clusters of brick and white apartment towers among trees on a hillside, below a long forested mountain ridge and a blue sky with clouds
author: Mussi Katz

caption: Bronze sculptures by Fernando Botero on Plaza Botero in central Medellín
alt: A paved plaza with large rounded bronze sculptures of animals and figures, palm trees and people walking between them
author: Steffen Schmitz (Carschten)

caption: A Metrocable cabin above Medellín, whose cable cars link hillside districts to the metro
alt: A white cable car cabin hanging from wires high above a city of brick towers spread across a valley, with mountains behind
author: JoranL

caption: The Placita de Flórez, a covered food market in Medellín
alt: A long yellow and green market building with produce stalls at its entrance, parked motorbikes and a yellow taxi on the street
author: Felipe Restrepo Acosta

caption: The wooden Orquideorama canopy in Medellín's botanical garden
alt: A tall open structure of hexagonal wooden lattice canopies on steel legs, with ferns and tropical plants beneath
author: CONOCER
